correctness.rationale: Exact invariant-subspace direct sum dimensions 1+(n-1)(n-2)+3(n-1)=n^2, explicit 3x3 action/characteristic cubic, unique monotone root, residual-root strict dominance, dissipativity for stationary uniqueness, differentiation of a globally bijective parameterization, and exact observable Laplace transform/residue establish the quantified all-n theorem. Independently assembled full generators agree in 50 spectra, 12 localized profiles/resolvents, and 40 optimization bracketing checks; finite cases are corroboration, not the proof.

evidence: Solenov--Fedichkin (2005) studies uniform cycles, deriving model-specific mixing estimates. For n=3 the graphs C3 and K3 coincide, but its treatment does not give the all-n complete-graph polynomial and optimizer.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The cycle result is not a theorem for all complete graphs; the trap model is nonconservative and its transfer rate does not bound, determine or dominate the untrapped trace-preserving Liouvillian gap. The numerical QC-distance trends anticipate qualitative nonmonotonicity, but neither numerics nor different observable formulas imply the unique closed optimal gamma and size scaling.

originality.rationale: The claimed full all-size complete-graph pure-site-dephasing superoperator characteristic polynomial, strictly dominant gap, globally unique optimal dephasing rate and localized-population decay exponent are not supplied by any of the four inspected closely related sources. The identical Haken--Strobl Lindblad model is already established and is not claimed as new; the 2022 work numerically considers the complete graph and a different QC-distance. The 2023 work analytically solves a distinct irreversible trapping/recombination problem. The older cycle model covers a different topology, except for the coincident three-site graph. Prioritization is provisional: an unlocated broader representation-theoretic Liouvillian result could contain this specialization.
residual_risks: A general permutation-covariant Lindblad semigroup spectral theorem not located could imply the cubic factorization and rate optimizer.
The complete-graph special case n=3 coincides with a three-cycle, and earlier cycle theory may already cover pieces of it.
Published-record search and this scientific assessment are not independent publication-priority determinations.

value.rationale: Exact optimal site-dephasing strength and relaxation exponent on a complete coherent network resolve a motivated open-system transport tuning problem for all n, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The inverse-n decay at fixed g,gamma is in structural contrast to the usual increasing connectivity heuristic, and the n-linear optimal retuning is an explicit usable scaling benchmark. The already known qualitative noise-rate inversion is credited; neither correctness nor numerical code alone establishes this value.
